issues.detail: The Greek 'ευωδιαν' (Euodian) and 'συντυχην' (Syntychēn) are proper names/groups, not verbs meaning 'to advise'. The Vietnamese translation treats them as the objects of a verb 'khuyên' (advise/exhort), which is not present in the Greek. The Greek structure is 'I pray [for] Euodians and Syntychēns [to have] this mindset in the Lord'.
